name: Inefficient Regex (ReDoS)
attack_scenario: a generated regex has a nested/overlapping quantifier (e.g. (a+)+ or (.*)*), so a crafted input triggers catastrophic backtracking and hangs the process — a denial of service
negative_test_hint: feed the string "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!" (40 a's then a '!') and assert the match returns in milliseconds, not seconds

exemplar.compliant: re.match(r'^[\w\s]{1,100}$', user_input)   # bounded, no nested quantifier; or use RE2/regex with a timeout
exemplar.explanation: avoid nested quantifiers over overlapping classes; rewrite to a linear form or use a backtracking-free engine
